note: Release attestation hardening (follow-up review of the SBOM / provenance release steps). Attestations are now signed by a separate `attest` job: the publishing job, which runs the changepacks CLI and build code, no longer holds `id-token: write` / `attestations: write`. Packages that did publish are attested even when another package failed to publish or to be collected, and a failed attestation can be retried with "Re-run failed jobs" without publishing again. No API change.
